expectations.text: Does not recommend photography or layout work the 12-day window cannot absorb
expectations.evidence: The response picks an 'in-page tier-table page' over a designed kit because 'You have no photos and a 12-day deadline, so a PDF kit would only add polish.' It suggests only exporting the same page to PDF. It leaves out brand photos, testimonials and the logo wall. It puts photo collection under 'After the edition'. The total effort estimate is about 2 hours to fill brackets and publish, with no design or photo work.

expectations.text: Does not recommend photography or layout work the 12-day window cannot absorb
expectations.evidence: The response never suggests a photo shoot, venue photography, a designed brochure or a branded visual layout. The prospectus is plain markdown with tables. The outreach kit covers only a cover email, a prospect order and a 20–30 personal-email plan, all of which fit before the 27 October start. The only design-related item is an optional offer at the end: 'plus a one-page PDF-ready layout if you want one.' That is small and the assistant would produce it, so it adds little load for the user. Logo files and printing appear only as sponsor deliverables with a deadline around 30 January 2027, out
